title: Physics: Motion and Forces
description: Move a cart, balance a force and follow the energy. Predict what happens next.
audience: An adult comfortable with signed numbers, ratios, basic algebra and square roots. No previous physics course is assumed.

modules.title: Describing motion
modules.summary: Position, distance, velocity and motion graphs.

concepts.title: Where did it go?
concepts.summary: Distinguish a change in position from the total distance travelled.

concepts.title: Speed and direction
concepts.summary: Use elapsed time to distinguish average speed from average velocity.

concepts.title: Read a motion graph
concepts.summary: Interpret a position–time graph as changing position, pauses and reversals.

concepts.summary: Read acceleration as a signed change in velocity per second.

concepts.summary: Apply constant downward acceleration to free fall and an upward throw.

modules.title: Forces on an object

concepts.title: When forces balance
concepts.summary: Add signed forces and distinguish balanced forces from being at rest.

concepts.title: Force, mass and acceleration
concepts.summary: Use net force and mass to predict how velocity changes.

concepts.title: Weight and support
concepts.summary: Distinguish mass, gravitational force and the force from a support.

concepts.title: Forces come in pairs
concepts.summary: Identify an interaction pair and explain why equal forces can produce different accelerations.

concepts.summary: Calculate signed work for forces along, against and perpendicular to displacement.
